notes: Two existential variables; the core is Tseitin's parity formula on the committed 3-regular graph on 12 vertices (18 universal variables, 48 clauses) with an odd total charge. The first existential assignment gets the whole contradiction, the other three lose one clause each.

Every answer set is saturated, so membership needs the complete check that no universal assignment satisfies its core: the frozen reduct's proper-subset query. On 24 vertices the subset queries walk about 56,000 regions.
